gaps.explanation: People are satisfied; things are satisfying or satisfactory.

gaps.sentence: The village is ___ (ACCESS) only by boat.
gaps.explanation: 'Accessible' = easy to reach; the -ible spelling follows 'access'.

gaps.sentence: The storm caused ___ (WIDE) damage along the coast.
gaps.explanation: 'Widespread damage' = damage across a large area.

gaps.sentence: Send your ___ (APPLY) to the address below.
gaps.explanation: 'Your application' — the document you send; an applicant is a person.

gaps.sentence: The law needs complete ___ (REVISE) before it can work.
The medicine may cause ___ (SLEEP), so avoid driving.
gaps.hint: noun: the state of wanting to sleep
gaps.explanation: 'Cause sleepiness' — the noun for the drowsy state.
